cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis with Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 as the defining ether/sulfonate-type anionic, prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5 and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @7, no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signal toward strong: the olefin sulfonate is the only early surfactant (alkanolamide and glycerin sit between it and the buffers), which lowers confidence but does not move the C1 value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - prominent Glycerin @4 and Glycol Distearate @6, plus Shea Butter @10, Sodium Hyaluronate @14 and two cationic polymers (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @19, Polyquaternium-7 @21) after the E3 point. C2 not met (no early silicone or prominent payload lipid); no W-RICH. Counter-signal: all depositing routes are after Parfum, so the formula could read as cleansing-led (low).
